contract.application_relevance: Applications separate object datasets with multiple bindings.
cleanup: After settled trace, finish/cancel every owned response body and finite input.
Abort any owned unfinished multipart upload before deleting keys; an active-request upload ID is never exported to another service.
Delete only registered synthetic keys; list both owned prefixes and require empty/nontruncated.
On unjoined trace or inaccessible reader, require external owned process/store teardown; never race cleanup against pending write.

contract.intent: Keep identical logical keys isolated between buckets
contract.oracle: A first-bucket; B second-bucket; A deletion leaves B readable.
preconditions: Exact reviewed direct celld source/build and fixture identities; no hybrid/mock execution.
Fresh owned private fleet-bucket backend supporting ordinary conditional writes and multipart; no real user bucket or cloud credentials entered here.
Two distinct R2 bindings in supplied config; per-case random key prefix independently witnessed empty; external limits and owned teardown mandatory.
contract.schedule: One active GET /case/I214; sequential awaited operations as written; all multipart handles and body readers stay inside this active request. I211 has at most six pages.
contract.source_note: Source-specific exceptions in docs/services/r2.md are respected: no distinct-version guarantee, UTF-8 listing order, cross-node multipart or large-stream condition claim.
